75.long: Walk left. On the floor it walks forward; on the ceiling it walks back.

77.long: Walk right. On the ceiling it walks forward; on the floor it walks back.

72.long: Walk up. Up the left wall it walks forward; down the right wall it walks back.

80.long: Walk down. Down the right wall it walks forward; up the left wall it walks back.

57.long: Jump off the wall, away from the surface you stand on. Steer along the wall with the arrow while you are in the air.

counters.20: Keys: not used here, but a copy can add them.
